overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Weston Public Works & Utility Committee was scheduled to meet on September 14, 2026, to review capital improvement projects, utility operations, and consider multiple street reconstruction and assessment matters. The meeting was set to address significant infrastructure items including Business 51 reconstruction, sewer easement agreements, and multiple street project assessments.

agenda.item: Approval of 8/10/26 Public Works & Utility Committee Minutes
Acknowledge August 2026 Water and Sewer Permits
Business 51 Reconstruction – Neupert Ave Pedestrian Crossing
Ferge Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
Howland Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
Alderson St and Jelinek Ave Change Order #2

discussions.item: Business 51 Reconstruction – Neupert Ave Pedestrian Crossing
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review the Business 51 reconstruction project with focus on the Neupert Avenue pedestrian crossing. This item was set for discussion with additional information expected to be presented, following a deferral from the August meeting to address impacts on businesses, parking, and signage.

The committee was set to discuss the Wausau Tile sanitary sewer easement request and related property agreements. Staff was expected to present updated information on the easement alignment, potentially including survey results to confirm easements align with previous surveys.

discussions.item: Ferge Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss the typical section design for the Ferge Avenue project as part of ongoing street reconstruction planning.

discussions.item: Howland Ave Project Typical Section Discussion
discussions.body: The committee was set to discuss the typical section design for the Howland Avenue project as part of ongoing street reconstruction planning.
The committee was scheduled to address gravel road maintenance matters for the Village.
The committee was set to review and potentially act on final assessments for the E Jelinek Avenue project.
The committee was scheduled to review and potentially act on final assessments for the Weston Avenue project.

discussions.item: Alderson St and Jelinek Ave Change Order #2
discussions.body: The committee was set to consider Change Order #2 for the Alderson Street and Jelinek Avenue project.
The committee was scheduled to discuss an update to the winter street parking ordinance.
The committee was set to receive an update on the status of various Capital Improvement Plan projects currently underway in the Village.
The committee was scheduled to receive an update on street operations from Public Works staff.
The committee was set to receive an update on utility operations from Village staff.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda as Item 5.
